description: OpenUtilities sisHYD provides thermal and hydraulic network calculations for district heating, cooling and gas distribution. Bentley documents pipe sizing, pressure-loss and velocity analysis, construction-cost comparisons and the visual display of network parameters. The provider is Bentley Systems. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: The provider page describes the software and supplies a contact route for access. No executable or example model was obtained. Licence and cost: Bentley offers paid subscriptions and separate academic access. Licence size and the selected product option affect price; a single universal price does not apply. Limitations: Published capabilities are provider claims. No model was run and numerical accuracy was not independently tested. For infrastructure simulation it supports comparison of operating conditions, network capacity and proposed equipment changes. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network calculations. This is a thematic relation, not a claim of software interoperability.
